svg.text: The branch is resolved in ID. mux_2 picks the address the branch really goes to; flush
fires when it differs from what fetch predicted. The prediction is compared with all
three candidates in parallel and decision & JR_bit_t only pick one mismatch bit (V2).
The comparators use bits 31..2 of p4_S and register_in. CAUSE_t is declared in the VHDL
